content_sections.body: In this lesson, focus on experience, contrast, opinion, and reasons in one connected response. Notice how the ideas about learning to cook are linked so that the listener can follow the speaker's meaning.
content_sections.title: Notice the language

content_sections.body: I have learned to cook several meals since moving away from home. At first it was difficult; however, I now think cooking is worth the effort because it saves money and brings friends together.
content_sections.title: Context and meaning

content_sections.body: Prepare a three-sentence response about learning to cook. Include the lesson language, one concrete detail, and a clear link between your ideas.
